title: Lewes
summary: Raleigh names Lewes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Lewes King of Fraunce, who assembled with Conrad the third at Ptolomais Acon in the yeere 1147. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XI, §. I, sig. 252b–253a
